physicalAnchorReview.method: Manually observed pelvis center immediately ahead of tail base, at the proximal rear-leg joint; the same body landmark is followed through biped idle, low stalking, crouch and collapse. Its vertical projection is the physical root, never the tail or skull center. Support floor is complete recovered pose padded bottom, visually checked against supporting legs/hands or terminal resting body; three source pixels of extraction guard included. Attack 3/4 are low forward reaches with supporting limbs, not a verified airborne pounce. This registration does not certify interclip scale or anatomical fidelity.
